function getMonday(d) {
  var date = new Date(d);
  var day = date.getDay();
  var diff = date.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
  date.setDate(diff);
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return date;
}
function addDays(date, days) {
  var d = new Date(date);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  return d;
}
function fmtDate(d) {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ AGENDA TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function AgendaTab(_ref10) {
  var appointments = _ref10.appointments,
    onUpdate = _ref10.onUpdate,
    onDelete = _ref10.onDelete,
    currentUser = _ref10.currentUser;
  var barbers = currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' ? BARBERS.filter(function (b) {
    return b.id === currentUser.id;
  }) : BARBERS;
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6"
  }, barbers.map(function (barber) {
    var appts = appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.barberId === barber.id;
    }).sort(function (a, b) {
      if (a.date !== b.date) return a.date.localeCompare(b.date);
      return a.time.localeCompare(b.time);
    });
    var grouped = {};
    appts.forEach(function (a) {
      if (!grouped[a.date]) grouped[a.date] = [];
      grouped[a.date].push(a);
    });
    return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
      key: barber.id,
      className: "bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5"
    }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex items-center gap-3 mb-4"
    }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(Avatar, {
      src: barber.avatar,
      name: barber.name,
      size: 10
    }), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", null, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("p", {
      className: "font-serif font-bold text-gray-900"
    }, barber.name), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-xs text-gray-400"
    }, barber.specialty)), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("span", {
      className: "ml-auto bg-[#C9A356]/10 text-[#C9A356] text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full"
    }, appts.length, " ag.")), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
      className: "flex flex-col gap-4"
    }, Object.keys(grouped).sort().map(function (date) {
      return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
        key: date
      }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("p", {
        className: "text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2"
      }, new Date(date + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', {
        weekday: 'long',
        day: '2-digit',
        month: 'short'
      })), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
        className: "flex flex-col gap-2"
      }, grouped[date].map(function (a) {
        return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(AppointmentCard, {
          key: a.id,
          appt: a,
          onUpdate: onUpdate,
          onDelete: onDelete
        });
      })));
    }), appts.length === 0 && /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("p", {
      className: "text-xs text-gray-400 text-center py-4"
    }, "Sem agendamentos")));
  }));
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ FINANCEIRO TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function FinanceiroTab(_ref11) {
  var appointments = _ref11.appointments;
  var total = appointments.filter(function (a) {
    return a.status === 'concluido';
  }).reduce(function (s, a) {
    return s + a.price;
  }, 0);
  var pending = appointments.filter(function (a) {
    return a.status === 'confirmado';
  }).reduce(function (s, a) {
    return s + a.price;
  }, 0);
  var commissions = BARBERS.map(function (b) {
    var barberAppts = appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.barberId === b.id && a.status === 'concluido';
    });
    var rev = barberAppts.reduce(function (s, a) {
      return s + a.price;
    }, 0);
    return _objectSpread(_objectSpread({}, b), {}, {
      revenue: rev,
      commission: rev * 0.4,
      appts: barberAppts.length
    });
  });
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "flex flex-col gap-6"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(KPICard, {
    label: "Receita Conclu\xEDda",
    value: "R$ ".concat(total),
    icon: "\u2705"
  }), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(KPICard, {
    label: "A Receber",
    value: "R$ ".concat(pending),
    icon: "\u23F3"
  }), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(KPICard, {
    label: "Atendimentos",
    value: appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'concluido';
    }).length,
    icon: "\uD83D\uDC88"
  }), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(KPICard, {
    label: "Ticket M\xE9dio",
    value: appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'concluido';
    }).length ? "R$ ".concat((total / appointments.filter(function (a) {
      return a.status === 'concluido';
    }).length).toFixed(0)) : 'R\$ 0',
    icon: "\uD83D\uDCCA"
  })), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", {
    className: "bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("h3", {
    className: "font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4"
  }, "Comiss\xF5es por Barbeiro"), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("table", {
    className: "w-full text-sm"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("thead", null, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("tr", {
    className: "border-b border-gray-100"
  }, /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("th", {

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ APP ROOT ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function App() {
  var _useState23 = useState(USERS[0]),
    _useState24 = _slicedToArray(_useState23, 2),
    currentUser = _useState24[0],
    setCurrentUser = _useState24[1];
  var _useState25 = useState('public'),
    _useState26 = _slicedToArray(_useState25, 2),
    view = _useState26[0],
    setView = _useState26[1];
  var _useState27 = useState(INITIAL_APPOINTMENTS),
    _useState28 = _slicedToArray(_useState27, 2),
    appointments = _useState28[0],
    setAppointments = _useState28[1];
  var handleEnterPortal = function handleEnterPortal() {
    var role = currentUser.role;
    if (role === 'cliente') setView('client');else if (role === 'barbeiro') setView('barber');else setView('management');
  };
  var handleSwitchRole = function handleSwitchRole(user) {
    setCurrentUser(user);
    if (view !== 'public') {
      var role = user.role;
      if (role === 'cliente') setView('client');else if (role === 'barbeiro') setView('barber');else setView('management');
    }
  };
  return /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement("div", null, view === 'public' && /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(PublicSite, {
    onEnterPortal: handleEnterPortal,
    currentUser: currentUser
  }), view === 'management' && /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(ManagementPanel, {
    currentUser: currentUser,
    appointments: appointments,
    setAppointments: setAppointments,
    onBack: function onBack() {
      return setView('public');
    }
  }), view === 'barber' && /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(BarbeiroPortal, {
    currentUser: currentUser,
    appointments: appointments,
    setAppointments: setAppointments,
    onBack: function onBack() {
      return setView('public');
    }
  }), view === 'client' && /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(ClientPortal, {
    currentUser: currentUser,
    appointments: appointments,
    onBack: function onBack() {
      return setView('public');
    }
  }), /*#__PURE__*/React.createElement(DemoRoleSwitcher, {
    currentUser: currentUser,
    onSwitch: handleSwitchRole
  }));
}
var root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));

function getMonday(d) {
  const date = new Date(d);
  const day = date.getDay();
  const diff = date.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
  date.setDate(diff);
  date.setHours(0, 0, 0, 0);
  return date;
}

function addDays(date, days) {
  const d = new Date(date);
  d.setDate(d.getDate() + days);
  return d;
}

function fmtDate(d) {
  return d.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ HELPERS ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function StatusPill({ status }) {
  const map = { confirmado: 'status-confirmado', pendente: 'status-pendente', concluido: 'status-concluido', cancelado: 'status-cancelado' };
  return <span className={`text-xs font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${map[status] || 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600'}`}>{status.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + status.slice(1)}</span>;
}

function Avatar({ src, name, size = 10 }) {
  if (src) return <img src={src} alt={name} className={`w-${size} h-${size} rounded-full object-cover`} onError={e => { e.target.style.display='none'; }} />;
  const initials = name ? name.split(' ').map(w => w[0]).join('').slice(0,2).toUpperCase() : '?';
  return <div className={`w-${size} h-${size} rounded-full bg-[#C9A356] flex items-center justify-center text-black font-bold text-sm`}>{initials}</div>;
}

function GoldBtn({ children, onClick, className = '', type = 'button', small = false }) {
  return (
    <button type={type} onClick={onClick}
      className={`bg-[#C9A356] hover:bg-[#B59044] text-black font-semibold rounded-xl transition-colors ${small ? 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs' : 'px-4 py-2 text-sm'} ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function OutlineBtn({ children, onClick, className = '', type = 'button', small = false, danger = false }) {
  const base = danger
    ? 'bg-white border border-red-200 text-red-600 hover:bg-red-50'
    : 'bg-white border border-gray-200 text-gray-700 hover:bg-gray-50';
  return (
    <button type={type} onClick={onClick}
      className={`${base} font-medium rounded-xl transition-colors ${small ? 'px-3 py-1.5 text-xs' : 'px-4 py-2 text-sm'} ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

function Input({ label, value, onChange, type = 'text', placeholder = '', className = '' }) {
  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col gap-1 ${className}`}>
      {label && <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</label>}
      <input type={type} value={value} onChange={onChange} placeholder={placeholder}
        className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C9A356] focus:border-[#C9A356] transition" />
    </div>
  );
}

function Select({ label, value, onChange, options, className = '' }) {
  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col gap-1 ${className}`}>
      {label && <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</label>}
      <select value={value} onChange={onChange}
        className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C9A356] focus:border-[#C9A356] transition">
        {options.map(o => <option key={o.value || o} value={o.value || o}>{o.label || o}</option>)}
      </select>
    </div>
  );
}

function KPICard({ label, value, sub, icon }) {
  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5 flex flex-col gap-1">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2">
        <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">{label}</span>
        {icon && <span className="text-xl">{icon}</span>}
      </div>
      <span className="text-3xl font-bold text-gray-900">{value}</span>
      {sub && <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{sub}</span>}
    </div>
  );
}

function Modal({ open, onClose, title, children }) {
  if (!open) return null;
  return (
    <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center modal-overlay" onClick={onClose}>
      <div className="bg-white rounded-3xl shadow-2xl p-6 w-full max-w-md mx-4 fade-in" onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}>
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
          <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-gray-900">{title}</h3>
          <button onClick={onClose} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 text-xl font-bold">&times;</button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-1">Demo ÔÇö Trocar Perfil</p>
      {USERS.map(u => (
        <button key={u.id} onClick={() => onSwitch(u)}
          className={`text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-xl font-medium transition-colors ${currentUser.id === u.id ? 'bg-[#C9A356] text-black' : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-200'}`}>
          {u.name} ({u.role})
        </button>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ PUBLIC SITE ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */

            <img src="logo_valverds_clean.png" alt="Valverd's" className="w-32 h-32 object-contain" onError={e => { e.target.style.display='none'; }} />

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 mt-4">
              <GoldBtn onClick={() => scrollTo('services')} className="px-8 py-3 text-base">Ver Servi├ºos</GoldBtn>
              <a href={`https://wa.me/${WA_PHONE}?text=Ol├í! Gostaria de agendar um hor├írio.`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
                className="bg-white/10 hover:bg-white/20 border border-white/20 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl px-8 py-3 text-base transition">
                ­ƒÆ¼ WhatsApp
              </a>
            </div>
            <button onClick={onEnterPortal}
              className="mt-2 text-xs text-gray-500 hover:text-[#C9A356] underline transition">
              Acessar Painel ÔåÆ
            </button>
          </div>
          <div className="absolute bottom-8 text-gray-500 text-sm animate-bounce">Ôåô</div>

            <h2 className="font-serif text-4xl font-bold text-center text-gray-900 mb-12">Excel├¬ncia em cada detalhe</h2>

          <p className="text-sm mb-4">{SHOP_ADDRESS}</p>
          <p className="text-xs">┬® {new Date().getFullYear()} Valverd's BarberShop. Todos os direitos reservados.</p>
        </footer>

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ APPOINTMENT CARD (inline edit/delete) ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function AppointmentCard({ appt, onUpdate, onDelete }) {
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [confirming, setConfirming] = useState(false);
  const [editStatus, setEditStatus] = useState(appt.status);
  const [editNotes, setEditNotes] = useState(appt.notes || '');

  const handleSave = () => {
    onUpdate(appt.id, { status: editStatus, notes: editNotes });
    setEditing(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = () => {
    onDelete(appt.id);
    setConfirming(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-gray-50 rounded-2xl p-4 flex flex-col gap-2 border border-gray-100">
      <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 flex-1 min-w-0">
          <span className="font-semibold text-gray-900 text-sm truncate">{appt.clientName}</span>
          <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{appt.time} ┬À {appt.service}</span>
          <span className="text-xs font-bold text-[#C9A356]">R\$ {appt.price}</span>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-shrink-0">
          <StatusPill status={appt.status} />
          <button onClick={() => { setEditing(!editing); setConfirming(false); }}
            title="Editar" className="text-gray-400 hover:text-[#C9A356] transition p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-gray-100">Ô£Å´©Å</button>
          <button onClick={() => { setConfirming(!confirming); setEditing(false); }}
            title="Remover" className="text-gray-400 hover:text-red-500 transition p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-red-50">­ƒùæ´©Å</button>
          <a href={`https://wa.me/${WA_PHONE}?text=Ol├í ${appt.clientName}! Confirmando seu agendamento para ${appt.service} ├ás ${appt.time}.`}
            target="_blank" rel="noreferrer" title="WhatsApp" className="text-gray-400 hover:text-green-500 transition p-1 rounded-lg hover:bg-green-50">­ƒÆ¼</a>
        </div>
      </div>

      {editing && (
        <div className="border-t border-gray-200 pt-3 flex flex-col gap-2 fade-in">
          <Select label="Status" value={editStatus} onChange={e => setEditStatus(e.target.value)}
            options={STATUS_OPTIONS.map(s => ({ value: s, label: s.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + s.slice(1) }))} />
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
            <label className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wide">Notas</label>
            <textarea value={editNotes} onChange={e => setEditNotes(e.target.value)} rows={2}
              className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-sm text-gray-800 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#C9A356] focus:border-[#C9A356] transition resize-none" />
          </div>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <GoldBtn small onClick={handleSave}>Salvar</GoldBtn>
            <OutlineBtn small onClick={() => setEditing(false)}>Cancelar</OutlineBtn>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {confirming && (
        <div className="border-t border-red-100 pt-3 flex flex-col gap-2 fade-in">
          <p className="text-xs text-red-600 font-medium">Tem certeza que deseja remover este agendamento?</p>
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <button onClick={handleDelete} className="bg-red-500 hover:bg-red-600 text-white font-semibold rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition">Confirmar</button>
            <OutlineBtn small onClick={() => setConfirming(false)}>Cancelar</OutlineBtn>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {appt.notes && !editing && (
        <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 italic truncate">{appt.notes}</p>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ AGENDA TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function AgendaTab({ appointments, onUpdate, onDelete, currentUser }) {
  const barbers = currentUser.role === 'barbeiro' ? BARBERS.filter(b => b.id === currentUser.id) : BARBERS;

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
      {barbers.map(barber => {
        const appts = appointments.filter(a => a.barberId === barber.id).sort((a, b) => {
          if (a.date !== b.date) return a.date.localeCompare(b.date);
          return a.time.localeCompare(b.time);
        });
        const grouped = {};
        appts.forEach(a => { if (!grouped[a.date]) grouped[a.date] = []; grouped[a.date].push(a); });

        return (
          <div key={barber.id} className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mb-4">
              <Avatar src={barber.avatar} name={barber.name} size={10} />
              <div>
                <p className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900">{barber.name}</p>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{barber.specialty}</p>
              </div>
              <span className="ml-auto bg-[#C9A356]/10 text-[#C9A356] text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">{appts.length} ag.</span>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              {Object.keys(grouped).sort().map(date => (
                <div key={date}>
                  <p className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">
                    {new Date(date + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { weekday: 'long', day: '2-digit', month: 'short' })}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
                    {grouped[date].map(a => (
                      <AppointmentCard key={a.id} appt={a} onUpdate={onUpdate} onDelete={onDelete} />
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
              {appts.length === 0 && <p className="text-xs text-gray-400 text-center py-4">Sem agendamentos</p>}
            </div>
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ PRODUCTS TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function ProductsTab() {
  const [products, setProducts] = useState(INITIAL_PRODUCTS);
  const [showForm, setShowForm] = useState(false);
  const [form, setForm] = useState({ name: '', stock: '', price: '', category: '' });

  const handleAdd = () => {
    if (!form.name) return;
    setProducts(p => [...p, { id: Date.now(), name: form.name, stock: parseInt(form.stock) || 0, price: parseFloat(form.price) || 0, category: form.category }]);
    setForm({ name: '', stock: '', price: '', category: '' });
    setShowForm(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-5 border-b border-gray-100">
        <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900">Produtos em Estoque</h3>
        <GoldBtn small onClick={() => setShowForm(!showForm)}>+ Adicionar</GoldBtn>
      </div>

      {showForm && (
        <div className="p-5 bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-100 flex flex-wrap gap-3 items-end fade-in">
          <Input label="Nome" value={form.name} onChange={e => setForm({...form, name: e.target.value})} className="flex-1 min-w-36" />
          <Input label="Estoque" value={form.stock} onChange={e => setForm({...form, stock: e.target.value})} type="number" className="w-24" />
          <Input label="Pre├ºo" value={form.price} onChange={e => setForm({...form, price: e.target.value})} type="number" className="w-28" />
          <Input label="Categoria" value={form.category} onChange={e => setForm({...form, category: e.target.value})} className="w-32" />
          <div className="flex gap-2">
            <GoldBtn small onClick={handleAdd}>Salvar</GoldBtn>
            <OutlineBtn small onClick={() => setShowForm(false)}>Cancelar</OutlineBtn>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-gray-100 bg-gray-50">
              <th className="text-left px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Nome</th>
              <th className="text-left px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Categoria</th>
              <th className="text-right px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Estoque</th>
              <th className="text-right px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Pre├ºo</th>
              <th className="px-5 py-3"></th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {products.map((p, i) => (
              <tr key={p.id} className={`border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition ${i % 2 === 0 ? '' : 'bg-gray-50/30'}`}>
                <td className="px-5 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">{p.name}</td>
                <td className="px-5 py-3 text-gray-500">{p.category}</td>
                <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right">
                  <span className={`font-semibold ${p.stock < 5 ? 'text-red-500' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>{p.stock}</span>
                </td>
                <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right font-medium text-gray-900">R\$ {p.price.toFixed(2)}</td>
                <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right">
                  <button onClick={() => setProducts(products.filter(x => x.id !== p.id))}
                    className="text-gray-300 hover:text-red-400 transition text-sm">­ƒùæ´©Å</button>
                </td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ FINANCEIRO TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function FinanceiroTab({ appointments }) {
  const total = appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido').reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0);
  const pending = appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'confirmado').reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0);
  const commissions = BARBERS.map(b => {
    const barberAppts = appointments.filter(a => a.barberId === b.id && a.status === 'concluido');
    const rev = barberAppts.reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0);
    return { ...b, revenue: rev, commission: rev * 0.4, appts: barberAppts.length };
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-6">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <KPICard label="Receita Conclu├¡da" value={`R\$ ${total}`} icon="Ô£à" />
        <KPICard label="A Receber" value={`R\$ ${pending}`} icon="ÔÅ│" />
        <KPICard label="Atendimentos" value={appointments.filter(a=>a.status==='concluido').length} icon="­ƒÆê" />
        <KPICard label="Ticket M├®dio" value={appointments.filter(a=>a.status==='concluido').length ? `R\$ ${(total / appointments.filter(a=>a.status==='concluido').length).toFixed(0)}` : 'R\$ 0'} icon="­ƒôè" />
      </div>
      <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5">
        <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Comiss├Áes por Barbeiro</h3>
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="border-b border-gray-100">
              <th className="text-left py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Barbeiro</th>
              <th className="text-right py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Atendimentos</th>
              <th className="text-right py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Receita</th>
              <th className="text-right py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Comiss├úo (40%)</th>
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {commissions.map(c => (
              <tr key={c.id} className="border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <td className="py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">{c.name}</td>
                <td className="py-3 text-right text-gray-600">{c.appts}</td>
                <td className="py-3 text-right text-gray-900 font-medium">R\$ {c.revenue}</td>
                <td className="py-3 text-right font-bold text-[#C9A356]">R\$ {c.commission.toFixed(2)}</td>
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ EQUIPE TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function EquipeTab() {
  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
      {BARBERS.map(b => (
        <div key={b.id} className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6 flex items-center gap-5">
          <Avatar src={b.avatar} name={b.name} size={16} />
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="font-serif font-bold text-lg text-gray-900">{b.name}</p>
            <p className="text-[#C9A356] text-sm font-medium mb-1">{b.specialty}</p>
            <p className="text-gray-400 text-sm">{b.bio}</p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-2">
              <span className="text-yellow-400 text-sm">Ôÿà</span>
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">{b.rating}</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <a href={`https://wa.me/${WA_PHONE}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
            className="bg-green-50 hover:bg-green-100 text-green-600 font-semibold rounded-xl px-3 py-1.5 text-xs transition">­ƒÆ¼</a>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ ESCALAS TAB ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function EscalasTab() {
  const days = ['Seg','Ter','Qua','Qui','Sex','S├íb'];
  return (
    <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
      <div className="p-5 border-b border-gray-100">
        <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900">Escala Semanal</h3>
      </div>
      <div className="overflow-x-auto">
        <table className="w-full text-sm">
          <thead>
            <tr className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-100">
              <th className="text-left px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Barbeiro</th>
              {days.map(d => <th key={d} className="px-3 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide text-center">{d}</th>)}
            </tr>
          </thead>
          <tbody>
            {BARBERS.map(b => (
              <tr key={b.id} className="border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                <td className="px-5 py-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Avatar src={b.avatar} name={b.name} size={8} />
                    <span className="font-medium text-gray-900 text-sm">{b.name}</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {days.map((d, i) => (
                  <td key={d} className="px-3 py-4 text-center">
                    {i < 5 ? (
                      <span className="text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700 font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">09ÔÇô19h</span>
                    ) : b.id === 'luis' ? (
                      <span className="text-xs bg-green-100 text-green-700 font-medium px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">09ÔÇô15h</span>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-xs bg-gray-100 text-gray-400 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full">Folga</span>
                    )}
                  </td>
                ))}
              </tr>
            ))}
          </tbody>
        </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ MANAGEMENT PANEL ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function ManagementPanel({ currentUser, appointments, setAppointments, onBack }) {
  const canSee = {
    agenda: true,
    fila: ['dono','recepcao','barbeiro'].includes(currentUser.role),
    produtos: ['dono','recepcao'].includes(currentUser.role),
    financeiro: ['dono'].includes(currentUser.role),
    escalas: ['dono','barbeiro'].includes(currentUser.role),
    equipe: ['dono'].includes(currentUser.role),
  };

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'agenda', label: 'Agenda', show: canSee.agenda },
    { id: 'fila', label: 'Fila', show: canSee.fila },
    { id: 'produtos', label: 'Produtos', show: canSee.produtos },
    { id: 'financeiro', label: 'Financeiro', show: canSee.financeiro },
    { id: 'escalas', label: 'Escalas', show: canSee.escalas },
    { id: 'equipe', label: 'Equipe', show: canSee.equipe },
  ].filter(t => t.show);

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState(tabs[0]?.id || 'agenda');

  const handleUpdate = (id, changes) => setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === id ? { ...a, ...changes } : a));
  const handleDelete = (id) => setAppointments(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== id));

  const today = fmtDate(new Date());
  const todayAppts = appointments.filter(a => a.date === today);
  const confirmedToday = todayAppts.filter(a => a.status === 'confirmado').length;
  const totalRevenue = appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido').reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0);

  const roleLabel = { dono: '­ƒææ Dono', barbeiro: 'Ô£é´©Å Barbeiro', recepcao: '­ƒôï Recep├º├úo' }[currentUser.role] || '';

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F5F5F7] font-sans">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-20 px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between h-14">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={onBack} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition text-sm">ÔåÉ Site</button>
            <span className="text-gray-200">|</span>
            <img src="logo_valverds_clean.png" alt="Logo" className="h-7 object-contain" onError={e=>{e.target.style.display='none';}} />
            <span className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 text-sm hidden sm:block">Valverd's</span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 hidden md:block">{roleLabel}</span>
            <Avatar src={currentUser.avatar} name={currentUser.name} size={8} />
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 leading-none">{currentUser.name}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-6">
        {/* KPIs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
          <KPICard label="Hoje" value={todayAppts.length} sub="agendamentos" icon="­ƒôà" />
          <KPICard label="Confirmados" value={confirmedToday} sub="para hoje" icon="Ô£à" />
          <KPICard label="Receita" value={`R\$ ${totalRevenue}`} sub="conclu├¡dos" icon="­ƒÆ░" />
          <KPICard label="Fila" value={appointments.filter(a=>a.status==='pendente').length} sub="pendentes" icon="ÔÅ│" />
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 rounded-t-2xl mb-0 flex overflow-x-auto">
          {tabs.map(t => (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setActiveTab(t.id)}
              className={`px-5 py-3 text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === t.id ? 'tab-active' : 'tab-inactive hover:text-gray-900'}`}>
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="pt-6 fade-in">
          {activeTab === 'agenda' && <AgendaTab appointments={appointments} onUpdate={handleUpdate} onDelete={handleDelete} currentUser={currentUser} />}
          {activeTab === 'fila' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
              {appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'pendente').map(a => (
                <AppointmentCard key={a.id} appt={a} onUpdate={handleUpdate} onDelete={handleDelete} />
              ))}
              {appointments.filter(a => a.status === 'pendente').length === 0 && (
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-8 text-center text-gray-400 text-sm">
                  Nenhum agendamento pendente ­ƒÄë
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
          {activeTab === 'produtos' && <ProductsTab />}
          {activeTab === 'financeiro' && <FinanceiroTab appointments={appointments} />}
          {activeTab === 'escalas' && <EscalasTab />}
          {activeTab === 'equipe' && <EquipeTab />}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ BARBEIRO PORTAL ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function BarbeiroPortal({ currentUser, appointments, setAppointments, onBack }) {
  const barber = BARBERS.find(b => b.id === currentUser.id) || BARBERS[0];
  const [weekOffset, setWeekOffset] = useState(0);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState('Semana');
  const viewModes = ['Semana','M├¬s','Grade','Hoje'];

  const handleUpdate = (id, changes) => setAppointments(prev => prev.map(a => a.id === id ? { ...a, ...changes } : a));
  const handleDelete = (id) => setAppointments(prev => prev.filter(a => a.id !== id));

  const baseMonday = getMonday(new Date());
  const weekStart = addDays(baseMonday, weekOffset * 7);
  const weekDays = Array.from({ length: 6 }, (_, i) => addDays(weekStart, i));

  const myAppts = appointments.filter(a => a.barberId === barber.id);

  const totalRevenue = myAppts.filter(a => a.status === 'concluido').reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0);
  const commission = totalRevenue * 0.4;

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F5F5F7] font-sans">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-20 px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between h-14">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={onBack} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition text-sm">ÔåÉ Site</button>
            <span className="text-gray-200">|</span>
            <img src="logo_valverds_clean.png" alt="Logo" className="h-7 object-contain" onError={e=>{e.target.style.display='none';}} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Avatar src={barber.avatar} name={barber.name} size={8} />
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 leading-none">{barber.name}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Ô£é´©Å Barbeiro</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-6">
        {/* Banner */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6 mb-6 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center gap-4">
          <Avatar src={barber.avatar} name={barber.name} size={20} />
          <div className="flex-1 text-center sm:text-left">
            <p className="font-serif font-bold text-xl text-gray-900">{barber.name}</p>
            <p className="text-[#C9A356] text-sm font-medium">{barber.specialty}</p>
            <p className="text-gray-400 text-xs mt-1">SegÔÇôS├íb: 09hÔÇô19h</p>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-gray-100 rounded-full p-1 flex gap-1">
            {viewModes.map(m => (
              <button key={m} onClick={() => setViewMode(m)}
                className={`text-xs px-3 py-1.5 rounded-full font-medium transition-colors ${viewMode === m ? 'pill-active' : 'pill-inactive hover:bg-white'}`}>
                {m}
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* KPIs */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 mb-6">
          <KPICard label="Agendamentos" value={myAppts.length} icon="­ƒôà" />
          <KPICard label="Conclu├¡dos" value={myAppts.filter(a=>a.status==='concluido').length} icon="Ô£à" />
          <KPICard label="Receita" value={`R\$ ${totalRevenue}`} icon="­ƒÆ░" />
          <KPICard label="Comiss├úo (40%)" value={`R\$ ${commission.toFixed(0)}`} icon="­ƒÆ©" />
        </div>

        {/* Week navigation */}
        {(viewMode === 'Semana' || viewMode === 'Grade') && (
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-4">
            <button onClick={() => setWeekOffset(wo => wo - 1)} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">ÔÇ╣</button>
            <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">
              {weekStart.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day:'2-digit', month:'short' })} ÔÇô {addDays(weekStart, 5).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { day:'2-digit', month:'short', year:'numeric' })}
            </p>
            <button onClick={() => setWeekOffset(wo => wo + 1)} className="bg-white border border-gray-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">ÔÇ║</button>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Week grid */}
        {(viewMode === 'Semana' || viewMode === 'Grade') && (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6 gap-3 mb-6">
            {weekDays.map(day => {
              const dayStr = fmtDate(day);
              const dayAppts = myAppts.filter(a => a.date === dayStr);
              const isToday = dayStr === fmtDate(new Date());
              return (
                <div key={dayStr} className={`bg-white rounded-2xl border p-3 flex flex-col gap-1 ${isToday ? 'border-[#C9A356]' : 'border-gray-100'}`}>
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase">{day.toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { weekday:'short' })}</p>
                  <p className={`text-2xl font-bold ${isToday ? 'text-[#C9A356]' : 'text-gray-900'}`}>{day.getDate()}</p>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{dayAppts.length} cliente{dayAppts.length !== 1 ? 's' : ''}</p>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* Appointments list */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5">
          <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">
            {viewMode === 'Hoje' ? 'Agendamentos de Hoje' : 'Meus Agendamentos'}
          </h3>
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
            {myAppts
              .filter(a => viewMode === 'Hoje' ? a.date === fmtDate(new Date()) : true)
              .sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date) || a.time.localeCompare(b.time))
              .map(a => (
                <AppointmentCard key={a.id} appt={a} onUpdate={handleUpdate} onDelete={handleDelete} />
              ))
            }
            {myAppts.filter(a => viewMode === 'Hoje' ? a.date === fmtDate(new Date()) : true).length === 0 && (
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-400 text-center py-4">Nenhum agendamento</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ CLIENT PORTAL ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function ClientPortal({ currentUser, appointments, onBack }) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState('proximo');
  const profile = INITIAL_CLIENT_PROFILE;
  const myAppts = appointments.filter(a => a.clientName === profile.name);
  const nextAppt = myAppts.filter(a => a.status !== 'cancelado' && a.date >= fmtDate(new Date())).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date))[0];

  const tabs = [
    { id: 'proximo', label: 'Pr├│ximo' },
    { id: 'calendario', label: 'Calend├írio' },
    { id: 'fidelidade', label: 'Fidelidade' },
    { id: 'historico', label: 'Hist├│rico' },
    { id: 'preferencias', label: 'Prefer├¬ncias' },
    { id: 'perfil', label: 'Meu Perfil' },
  ];

  const tierColors = { Gold: 'text-yellow-600 bg-yellow-50', Silver: 'text-gray-500 bg-gray-100', Bronze: 'text-orange-600 bg-orange-50' };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-[#F5F5F7] font-sans">
      {/* Header */}
      <header className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 sticky top-0 z-20 px-4 md:px-8">
        <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between h-14">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button onClick={onBack} className="text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600 transition text-sm">ÔåÉ Site</button>
            <span className="text-gray-200">|</span>
            <img src="logo_valverds_clean.png" alt="Logo" className="h-7 object-contain" onError={e=>{e.target.style.display='none';}} />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <Avatar src={null} name={profile.name} size={8} />
            <div className="hidden sm:block">
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900 leading-none">{profile.name}</p>
              <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">­ƒæñ Cliente</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </header>

      <div className="max-w-4xl mx-auto px-4 md:px-8 py-6">
        {/* Hero banner */}
        <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6 mb-6 flex items-center gap-4">
          <Avatar src={null} name={profile.name} size={16} />
          <div className="flex-1">
            <p className="font-serif font-bold text-xl text-gray-900">{profile.name}</p>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mt-1">
              <span className={`text-xs font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${tierColors[profile.tier] || ''}`}>Ô¡É {profile.tier}</span>
              <span className="text-xs text-gray-400">{profile.points} pontos</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right hidden sm:block">
            <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-gray-900">{profile.totalVisits}</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">visitas</p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Tabs */}
        <div className="bg-white border-b border-gray-200 rounded-t-2xl flex overflow-x-auto mb-0">
          {tabs.map(t => (
            <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setActiveTab(t.id)}
              className={`px-4 py-3 text-sm font-semibold whitespace-nowrap transition-colors ${activeTab === t.id ? 'tab-active' : 'tab-inactive hover:text-gray-900'}`}>
              {t.label}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="pt-6 fade-in">
          {/* Pr├│ximo */}
          {activeTab === 'proximo' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              {nextAppt ? (
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6">
                  <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#C9A356] uppercase tracking-wide mb-3">Pr├│ximo Agendamento</p>
                  <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-2xl text-gray-900 mb-1">{nextAppt.service}</h3>
                  <p className="text-gray-500 text-sm mb-4">
                    {new Date(nextAppt.date + 'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { weekday:'long', day:'2-digit', month:'long' })} ├ás {nextAppt.time}
                  </p>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <StatusPill status={nextAppt.status} />
                    <span className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900">R\$ {nextAppt.price}</span>
                  </div>
                  <a href={`https://wa.me/${WA_PHONE}?text=Ol├í! Confirmo meu agendamento para ${nextAppt.service} em ${nextAppt.date} ├ás ${nextAppt.time}.`}
                    target="_blank" rel="noreferrer"
                    className="mt-4 inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-green-50 hover:bg-green-100 text-green-600 font-semibold rounded-xl px-4 py-2 text-sm transition">
                    ­ƒÆ¼ Confirmar via WhatsApp
                  </a>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-8 text-center">
                  <p className="text-4xl mb-3">­ƒôà</p>
                  <p className="font-semibold text-gray-600 mb-2">Sem agendamentos futuros</p>
                  <a href={`https://wa.me/${WA_PHONE}?text=Ol├í! Gostaria de agendar um hor├írio.`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
                    <GoldBtn>Agendar agora</GoldBtn>
                  </a>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Calend├írio */}
          {activeTab === 'calendario' && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-5">
              <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900 mb-4">Calend├írio de Agendamentos</h3>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                {myAppts.sort((a,b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).map(a => (
                  <div key={a.id} className="flex items-center gap-4 p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                    <div className="bg-[#C9A356]/10 text-[#C9A356] rounded-xl p-2 text-center min-w-[50px]">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold">{new Date(a.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR',{month:'short'}).toUpperCase()}</p>
                      <p className="text-xl font-bold">{new Date(a.date+'T12:00:00').getDate()}</p>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <p className="font-semibold text-gray-900 text-sm">{a.service}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">{a.time}</p>
                    </div>
                    <StatusPill status={a.status} />
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Fidelidade */}
          {activeTab === 'fidelidade' && (
            <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
              <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6">
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#C9A356] uppercase tracking-wide mb-2">Programa de Fidelidade</p>
                <div className="flex items-end gap-2 mb-4">
                  <span className="text-5xl font-bold text-gray-900">{profile.points}</span>
                  <span className="text-gray-400 mb-1">pontos</span>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-gray-100 rounded-full h-3 mb-2">
                  <div className="bg-[#C9A356] h-3 rounded-full transition-all" style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, (profile.points / 500) * 100)}%` }} />
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-400">Faltam {500 - profile.points} pontos para o pr├│ximo n├¡vel</p>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <KPICard label="Tier atual" value={profile.tier} icon="Ô¡É" />
                <KPICard label="Total gasto" value={`R\$ ${profile.totalSpent}`} icon="­ƒÆ©" />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Hist├│rico */}
          {activeTab === 'historico' && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
              <div className="p-5 border-b border-gray-100">
                <h3 className="font-serif font-bold text-gray-900">Hist├│rico de Visitas</h3>
              </div>
              <table className="w-full text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-gray-50 border-b border-gray-100">
                    <th className="text-left px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Data</th>
                    <th className="text-left px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Servi├ºo</th>
                    <th className="text-right px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Valor</th>
                    <th className="px-5 py-3 text-xs font-semibold text-gray-400 uppercase tracking-wide">Status</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {myAppts.sort((a,b) => b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).map(a => (
                    <tr key={a.id} className="border-b border-gray-50 hover:bg-gray-50 transition">
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-gray-600">{new Date(a.date+'T12:00:00').toLocaleDateString('pt-BR')}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 font-medium text-gray-900">{a.service}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3 text-right font-bold text-gray-900">R\$ {a.price}</td>
                      <td className="px-5 py-3"><StatusPill status={a.status} /></td>
                    </tr>
                  ))}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Prefer├¬ncias */}
          {activeTab === 'preferencias' && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6 flex flex-col gap-4">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#C9A356] uppercase tracking-wide">Minhas Prefer├¬ncias</p>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Barbeiro preferido</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.preferences.barber}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500">Servi├ºo favorito</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.preferences.service}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mb-1">Observa├º├Áes</p>
                  <p className="text-sm font-medium text-gray-900">{profile.preferences.notes}</p>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* Meu Perfil */}
          {activeTab === 'perfil' && (
            <div className="bg-white rounded-2xl border border-gray-100 shadow-sm p-6">
              <p className="text-xs font-semibold text-[#C9A356] uppercase tracking-wide mb-4">Meu Perfil</p>
              <div className="flex flex-col gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">Nome</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.name}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">E-mail</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.email}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">Telefone</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.phone}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">Tier</span>
                  <span className={`text-sm font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full ${tierColors[profile.tier] || ''}`}>Ô¡É {profile.tier}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">Membro desde</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{new Date(profile.memberSince).toLocaleDateString('pt-BR', { month:'long', year:'numeric' })}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">Total de visitas</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-900">{profile.totalVisits}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-xl">
                  <span className="text-sm text-gray-500 font-medium">Total gasto</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-[#C9A356]">R\$ {profile.totalSpent}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ APP ROOT ÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇÔöÇ */
function App() {
  const [currentUser, setCurrentUser] = useState(USERS[0]);
  const [view, setView] = useState('public');
  const [appointments, setAppointments] = useState(INITIAL_APPOINTMENTS);

  const handleEnterPortal = () => {
    const role = currentUser.role;
    if (role === 'cliente') setView('client');
    else if (role === 'barbeiro') setView('barber');
    else setView('management');
  };

  const handleSwitchRole = (user) => {
    setCurrentUser(user);
    if (view !== 'public') {
      const role = user.role;
      if (role === 'cliente') setView('client');
      else if (role === 'barbeiro') setView('barber');
      else setView('management');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div>
      {view === 'public' && (
        <PublicSite onEnterPortal={handleEnterPortal} currentUser={currentUser} />
      )}
      {view === 'management' && (
        <ManagementPanel
          currentUser={currentUser}
          appointments={appointments}
          setAppointments={setAppointments}
          onBack={() => setView('public')}
        />
      )}
      {view === 'barber' && (
        <BarbeiroPortal
          currentUser={currentUser}
          appointments={appointments}
          setAppointments={setAppointments}
          onBack={() => setView('public')}
        />
      )}
      {view === 'client' && (
        <ClientPortal
          currentUser={currentUser}
          appointments={appointments}
          onBack={() => setView('public')}
        />
      )}
      <DemoRoleSwitcher currentUser={currentUser} onSwitch={handleSwitchRole} />
    </div>
  );
}

const root = ReactDOM.createRoot(document.getElementById('root'));
root.render(<App />);
</script>

</body></html>
